### 批量添加网段 / Bulk subnet entry

- 设置 → 网络新增「批量添加网段」，支持每行一个 IPv4 CIDR（/22 至 /30）。预览会规范化网络地址、去重并显示新增网段、重复项和保存后的总探测地址数。
- 无效输入显示行号；保存后总数超过 20 段时整批拒绝，不静默截断。主进程再次验证并追加到最新列表，保留预览后同步到的网段及其来源。
- 「确认添加」只保存，不立即扫描。扫描仍使用已保存网段的刷新按钮，或主界面的全局扫描确认。
- Settings → Network now accepts multiple IPv4 CIDRs, one per line (/22–/30). Preview canonical ranges, duplicates, additions and the total unique probe-address count before saving.
- Invalid lines and inputs exceeding 20 saved ranges are rejected as a whole. The main process validates again and appends against the latest state, preserving concurrently shared ranges and their source metadata.
- Confirmation only saves. Scanning remains an explicit per-range refresh or the existing confirmed global scan.

### 验证 / Validation

- Linux 本地通过 138 个测试文件 / 1011 项测试、Electron 22 ABI 数据库自测、双端类型检查、构建、渲染体积、双语文档与版本一致性检查、Xvfb 冒烟。
- `npm run build` 后运行 `DISPLAY=:99 npm run test:bulk-ranges`：真实 Electron 22 设置界面验收规范化/去重预览、保存与持久化、无效/超限输入、主进程独立验证和中英文即时切换。隔离数据，拒绝所有非回环 UDP 发送，确认导入未触发网段扫描。
- 以上为 Linux Xvfb 下的本地验证；UOS/麒麟 ARM64、Windows 7 及真实跨网段环境仍需目标机验证。
- Linux validation passed 1011 tests in 138 files, Electron ABI database checks, both typecheck targets, build/bundle budgets, bilingual docs/version checks and Xvfb smoke. The real Electron UI/IPC test covers preview, persistence, invalid/over-limit input and live language switching with isolated data and no non-loopback UDP sends. UOS/Kylin ARM64, Windows 7 and real routed networks remain unverified.
